quotations.old_english: Þá geceás hé Laurentium ... and hé þurhwunode in his cwide (sententia)
Hé ná tó him hwearf æfter heora cwyde (gecwide, v.l. condictum) ... wæs hé gemyndig heora cwydes

source_text: cwide; IV. add :-- Þá geceás hé Laurentium ... and hé þurhwunode in his cwide (sententia), Gr. D. 329, 18. VIII. an agreement :-- Hé ná tó him hwearf æfter heora cwyde (gecwide, v.l. condictum) ... wæs hé gemyndig heora cwydes, Bd. 4, 25; Sch. 329, 18. v. folc-, heáfod-c.
